# Silver Fox Dynamics (SMC-Private) Limited

> Silver Fox Dynamics is a global, remote-first software engineering and digital services company based in Pakistan. We specialize in custom website development, Shopify and WooCommerce e-commerce solutions, website maintenance care, security hardening, speed optimization, technical SEO, and custom enterprise software platforms.

## Corporate Identity
- **Legal Name**: Silver Fox Dynamics (SMC-Private) Limited
- **Operating Model**: Remote-First Global Engineering Team
- **Official Website**: https://silverfoxdynamics.com
- **Primary Contact Email**: info@silverfoxdynamics.com
- **WhatsApp Support**: +92 329 5103414
- **Official Social Profiles**:

  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/silver-fox-dynamics/

## Published Software Products & SaaS Platforms
- [EventOS](https://eos.silverfoxdynamics.com/): Event management SaaS platform.
- [Restaurant ERP (RMS)](https://rms.silverfoxdynamics.com): Cloud restaurant POS & inventory software.
- [AnyDown](https://anydown.silverfoxdynamics.com): Media downloader web app & Google Play Store application.
- [Do Not Panic](https://www.donotpanic.live): Emergency response & productivity platform.
- [ScanDoc](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/products/#scandoc): Document scanning utility.
- [WeatherNow](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/products/#weathernow): Real-time weather tracking utility.
- [Goldmine](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/products/#goldmine): Commodity & gold tracking software.

## Guides & Resources
- [Engineering Guides & E-Commerce Insights](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/): Index of practical web development, e-commerce, SEO, and website maintenance guides.
- [Shopify vs WooCommerce for Emerging Markets: Technical Comparison](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/shopify-vs-woocommerce-emerging-markets/): Compares fees, mobile payments, and performance for businesses in Africa, South Asia, and other emerging markets.
- [How to Accept Mobile Money & Online Payments on Your Website](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/accepting-mobile-money-website/): Integrating mobile money (M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, GCash) and regional gateways (Paystack, Flutterwave).
- [How to Connect WhatsApp to Your Website for Sales & Support](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/connecting-whatsapp-to-website/): Click-to-chat widgets, product catalog sharing, and WhatsApp Business API order notifications.
- [How to Get Your Business Found on Google: Local & Technical SEO](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/get-business-found-on-google/): Technical SEO, Google Business Profile, structured data, and search-intent content.
- [Essential Monthly Website Maintenance Checklist for Business](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/website-maintenance-checklist/): Security hardening, plugin updates, database optimization, and backup verification.
- [Why Your Website is Slow on Mobile Networks (And How to Fix It)](https://silverfoxdynamics.com/resources/why-website-slow-mobile-networks/): Causes of slow pages on 3G and 4G networks and how to improve Core Web Vitals.
